verdict.rationale: Alma states it serves companies as well as individuals. Its pricing includes a Growth tier for 26-250 foreign nationals with "visibility and control," and it describes a system that keeps every case moving with visibility at every step, managed in under an hour per week. That is a stated multi-case employer program well beyond single founder cases. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the multi-case dashboard or portal features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of program management.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases
